# The modules the nginx provider and svcctl packages, and their tests, may
# depend on (CON-7: no new dependency). The list is every module `go list
# -deps -test` reaches from them, standard library excluded. Adding a line is
# a deliberate act that a reviewer sees: this file replaces a diff against
# the feature branch's base commit, which fails after the merge and checks
# nothing in a checkout without that commit (code review B, CR-B8).
